sar.narrative: Customer C10434 card C10434-K1 used in a $1000.03 online transaction from a new device (Windows 10 / Edge 16.0). Both purchaser and recipient emails are anonymous.com. The device is shared with cards C02354-K2 and C07987-K2 belonging to different customers. Card C10434-K1 is further connected via shared device profiles to 9 additional cards across 9 customers, indicating a coordinated account takeover ring. Historical precedents (CC-2752, CC-4562, CC-4644) confirm similar patterns as fraud. Transaction declined and all connected cards blocked.
